author: TeIq
content:
Architect verdict: APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOW-UPS.

Independent verification:
- cargo tree -p polaris-types --depth 1: 4 deps (chrono, serde, serde_json, uuid). No proto-blue. AC-8 satisfied.
- cargo build -p polaris-types -p xtask: clean.
- cargo clippy -p polaris-types -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean.
- cargo fmt --check: clean.
- Forbidden-pattern grep across all polaris-*/src and xtask/src: zero hits for unwrap()/expect(/todo!()/unimplemented!()/dbg!/crate-root #![allow].
- workspace.lints baseline present in root Cargo.toml; every member crate has [lints] workspace = true.
- proto-blue MSRV bug reproduced independently: proto-blue 0.3.1 declares rust-version=1.85 but uses Rust 1.88 let-chain syntax in proto-blue-identity, proto-blue-ws, proto-blue-lexicon.

Polaris-side scaffold is correct. The cargo build --workspace failure is upstream, not in this issue's scope.

Follow-ups filed:
- proto-blue tracker: bug report on the MSRV/let-chain mismatch.
- Polaris #50: workspace MSRV resolution decision; blocks #8 and #10 until resolved.

Subagent's leptos=0.8.3 pin is documented + acceptable as a workspace-coordination choice; will be relaxed when MSRV is decided.

No other deviations from the pre-flight.
